description: Laws of Malaysia from the Attorney General's Chambers (lom.agc.gov.my). Official source. LOM hides full text behind a signed processFile.php?token= link; the identifier is the full official document URL (processFile.php?token=... or the ilims/upload/... .pdf it resolves to). The connector downloads that PDF and extracts its text layer. Verified 2026-09-07 on Act 883 Records (Disposal) (Sarawak) Act 1955.
identifier_label: Full official LOM PDF URL (processFile.php?token=... harvested from the site)
